description: This file handles the display logic for related lists in the FAQs module of vtiger CRM, including entity retrieval, session management for related modules, and template rendering.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Class representing CRM entities, used to retrieve entity information based on module.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Extended Smarty class used for rendering templates within vtiger CRM.

classes.name: RelatedListViewSession
classes.description: Class managing session data for related list views.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method to retrieve CRMEntity instance for a specific module.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Method to load entity details based on record ID and module.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Function retrieving related lists for the current module and entity.

methods.name: addRelatedModuleToSession
methods.description: Session management method to add related modules to session data.

methods.name: getRelatedModulesFromSession
methods.description: Retrieve list of related modules from session data.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Get the sequence number field for a module, if any.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Fetch update information (such as last modified date) for an entity.

methods.name: CheckFieldPermission
methods.description: Check user permissions for specific fields in modules.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Function to determine permissions for certain buttons or actions.
